finding: While the majority of women reported respectful care, specific questions stratified by mode of birth, age, and ethnicity are important to identify those mistreated during care.
mod_finding: Women who had caesarean sections were less likely to report poor care during childbirth than those with vaginal births, however, babies born by caesarean had a 98% decrease in the odds of receiving skin-to-skin contact than those with vaginal births.
